body.x: HisSHOW(www.hisshow.co.kr) introduced 'HisSHOW BIBLE' christian smart content at '2014 International CES', the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

Hisshow Bible is a character animation content which contains modernistically dramatized characters and episodes from Bible. It enables existing animations and education programs available on smart devices. It consists of animation DVD, workbook and school program, having Spanish as well as English version to launch overseas.

Lee Wooho, HisShow Edu Director explained: "I am really happy to show off English version and Spanish version here. We have already great success that more than 10 churches came to our members. I expect much better future."

HisSHOW participated in the show as it had been selected for excellent startups by SmartContentCenter, and equally placed its service to have foreign reporters learn the service at Showstoppers which was important media press event. Furthermore, HisSHOW had chance to get advice on global marketing from Strong Ventures CEO John Nam, Tapas media CEO Chang-Won Kim, KOTRA SV Sung-Kyu Lee at 3:1 'CES Global Consulting Program'

'CES(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
